text:
alex: Planning v2 API rollout tonight in the 02:00-04:00 UTC window. Main risk: EU probe had intermittent timeouts earlier. Need operator signoff and deploy-bot schedule.

jamie: Copy. Staged ramp percentages?

alex: 5% -> 20% -> 50% with 10m observation between steps.

priya: Release notes almost ready. I'll include a clear client pin section and mobile SDK guidance.

maria: FYI EU probe had a 12% timeout spike 00:38-01:12 UTC. If it recurs we should divert new connections to eu-edge-legacy. :rotating_light:

jamie: Agreed. Suggest adding temporary mobile UA header gate so we can opt-out mobile quickly.

alex: Ops, can deploy-bot create the job and include diversion and rollback actions?

deploy-bot: Job created: v2-roll-8614871234. Steps: 1) canary 5% (02:10 UTC) 2) observe 10m 3) ramp 20% (02:30) 4) observe 10m 5) ramp 50% (03:00) 6) full (03:40). Fallbacks: rollback to v1; divert to eu-edge-legacy; apply X-Redwood-Client-Pin header.

oncall-sre: SRE oncall tagged. If EU probe timeout >5% for 3m during observe window we hold and run hotpatch.

jamie: What's the hotpatch?

alex: Increase prober socket timeout from 3s -> 6s, prober-side retry tweak, and a short-lived connection-pool config change. Reversible.

priya: Drafted note: "If you see client 5xx increase, set header X-Redwood-Client-Pin: v1 to opt-out of v2. Mobile SDKs will be notified"

maria: Ops checklist before start: confirm job, run preflight probe, prepare pinlist (tenant ids + mobile UA regex), merge release notes.

alex: All set except preflight. jamie/oncall-sre please run 30m before window.

jamie: Running preflight now. Output: PROBER EU median 120ms p95 420ms timeouts 2/1000; AUTH TTL test 200ms; KV cache hit 87%. Small noise but OK.

maria: Playbook updated with divert command: `/deploybot divert v2 -> eu-edge-legacy --reason "prober-timeout"`.

alex: Explicit rollback criteria: sustained 5xx increase >2% abs for 10m OR prober timeout >5% for 3m OR p99 latency >2x baseline for 10m -> hold, divert, hotpatch.

priya: Pinlist uploaded: s3://redwood-release/v2/pins/8614871234.json (mobile UA regex in a separate file).

deploy-bot: To start: `/deploybot start v2-roll-8614871234`. Emergency: `/deploybot abort v2-roll-8614871234 --rollback-to v1`. Note: pinned tenants skipped during ramp.

oncall-sre: Dashboards added (api.v2.canary, prober.eu.timeouts, auth.latency). Pager thresholds tightened for window.

jamie: Heads-up: header casing is normalized in v2; adding migration blurb in release notes.

priya: Added header casing note and SDK contact. Will merge PR once canary passes 20%.

maria: Ops signoff: :thumbsup: Ready to run.

alex: Product/eng signoff. I'll DM top tenants. If we hit hold we'll update this thread and post incident summary in release notes.

jamie: I'll open watch channel at 01:50 UTC and post canary stats every 10m.

maria: Thanks team. Eyes on EU. :eyes:
